claim_statement: Prepared coherent Rydberg superpositions can show radial probability motion and collapse/revival.
established_kernel: Wave-packet interference between discrete energy states is observed in the cited experiment.
standard_equation_or_locator: Psi(r,t)=sum c_n R_nl Y_lm exp(-i E_n t/hbar)
proposed_component: Use pulsing as a probability-density observable rather than an electron surface.
observable_or_endpoint: Radial density/current; revival timing; pump-probe ionization.
falsifier_or_next_test: Replay a disclosed hydrogenic wave-packet calculation and compare held-out revival times.
limitations: Prepared superposition only; not evidence for ether or a universal atomic pulse.

claim_statement: A hydrogen 1s eigenstate has stationary probability density.
established_kernel: A single energy eigenstate changes only by a global phase.
proposed_component: Reject literal radial electron-shell pulsing for the ground state.
null_model: Nonzero time dependence would require a superposition or an additional interaction.
falsifier_or_next_test: Check analytic density and numerical propagation under the declared Hamiltonian.
limitations: Stationarity is derived from the eigenstate equation; S002 is the spectroscopy benchmark, not an independent proof. Measurement language must distinguish radial probability from a material surface.

claim_statement: Hydrogen spectral frequencies are transition-energy observables, not a universal mass-frequency law.
established_kernel: Precision 1S-2S spectroscopy provides a transition frequency and uncertainty.
proposed_component: "Test any added substrate term as a line shift or broadening."
null_model: QED plus reduced-mass and known systematic corrections.
falsifier_or_next_test: A proposed term must produce a predeclared residual exceeding uncertainty without violating other lines.
limitations: Mass affects isotope shifts but does not determine all electronic frequencies.

claim_statement: Hydrogen and antihydrogen spectroscopy provide a charge-sign/CPT null for an opposite-phase bubble model.
established_kernel: The cited antihydrogen result is consistent with hydrogen within its reported precision.
standard_equation_or_locator: Compare matched transition frequencies under controlled fields.
falsifier_or_next_test: Pre-register a matched H/anti-H comparison and nuisance model.
limitations: Null agreement constrains a class of models; it does not prove all CPT alternatives absent.

claim_statement: The electron magnetic moment is a precision gate for any electron-as-bubble construction.
established_kernel: The anomalous magnetic moment is measured to high precision.
proposed_component: Add a finite-size or substrate form factor only if it predicts a residual.
observable_or_endpoint: Magnetic moment and scattering form factor.
falsifier_or_next_test: A residual must survive independent magnetic-moment and compositeness constraints.
limitations: No finite electron surface is established by the attached proposal.

claim_statement: A Bosenova is nonlinear BEC collapse after controlled interaction tuning.
established_kernel: Attractive interaction produces collapse, bursts, and remnant dynamics.
proposed_component: Use as a collapse-release benchmark, not as a supernova identity.
observable_or_endpoint: Atom burst, remnant oscillation, collapse time.
falsifier_or_next_test: Reproduce the reported qualitative regime and test any cross-domain scaling on held-out parameters.
limitations: Bosonic many-body dynamics differ from nuclear or relativistic stellar collapse.

claim_statement: The ultramassive white dwarf is a compact-matter benchmark with model-dependent ONe preference.
established_kernel: Mass, radius, and gravitational-redshift constraints are reported in an accepted preprint.
standard_equation_or_locator: Hydrostatic equilibrium with degenerate-electron equation of state.
falsifier_or_next_test: Compare alternative core models with independent spectroscopy and cooling data.
limitations: Accepted preprint; Bayes factor is modest and core inference is model-dependent.

claim_statement: A discrete substrate would need a covariant effective correction and measurable signature.
established_kernel: Discreteness and foam are active quantum-gravity hypotheses, not observed bubbles.
standard_equation_or_locator: E^2=p^2 c^2+m^2 c^4+eta_n p^2 c^2(E/M_star c^2)^n
proposed_component: "Parameterize rather than assume a foam medium."
observable_or_endpoint: Dispersion, birefringence, interferometer noise, atomic shifts.
falsifier_or_next_test: Confront the first nonzero predicted coefficient with gamma-ray, clock, interferometer, and GW limits.
limitations: A model with no observable residual is operationally equivalent to standard fields.

claim_statement: Discrete information-processing models already derive relativistic field limits in some constructions.
established_kernel: Quantum cellular automata and related discrete approaches are established prior art.
standard_equation_or_locator: Unitary, local, homogeneous, isotropic update rules and continuum limits.
proposed_component: Use prior art to define the exact delta rather than claim first discovery.
falsifier_or_next_test: Write a novelty comparison with canonical citations and no priority language until the delta is formal.
limitations: Prior-art coverage is bounded, not an exhaustive literature review.

claim_statement: Pressure language must map to stress-energy and metric observables before it can be a gravity claim.
established_kernel: Gravity tests constrain free fall, redshift, lensing, orbital, and wave behavior.
standard_equation_or_locator: T_munu and metric field equations; domain-specific stress tensors.
proposed_component: Create a stress-flux ledger across domains.
observable_or_endpoint: Free-fall composition dependence; clock redshift; lensing; GW speed.
null_model: General relativity plus tested matter models.
falsifier_or_next_test: Derive one unit-consistent constitutive bridge and test it against a held-out gravity observable.
limitations: A scalar pressure gradient alone is insufficient.

claim_statement: AGN jets can inflate cavities in surrounding plasma without implying black-hole explosion or reset.
established_kernel: X-ray cavities and shocks are observed as feedback signatures.
standard_equation_or_locator: Accretion/jet energy transfer and plasma dynamics.
proposed_component: Define any reset model by entropy and a ringdown/echo observable.
observable_or_endpoint: Cavity energetics; ringdown residual; echo waveform.
null_model: Standard accretion and GR black-hole model.
falsifier_or_next_test: Pre-register an echo or area-law deviation test and preserve null results.
limitations: Information-node language is metaphor until a state law and signal are specified.

claim_statement: Simple non-time-dilating tired-light models face a strong supernova time-dilation constraint.
established_kernel: DES supernova light-curve widths scale approximately as 1+z.
proposed_component: "Build a joint redshift discriminator rather than fit Hubble distance alone."
observable_or_endpoint: Time dilation, line width, blur, surface brightness, CMB T(z), BAO, lensing.
null_model: Expanding metric plus source and calibration nuisance models.
falsifier_or_next_test: A static model must fit the joint likelihood without hidden time-dilation assumptions.
limitations: This constrains simple static models; it does not rule out every engineered alternative.

claim_statement: JWST early-galaxy tension primarily tests galaxy formation, not the existence of expansion.
established_kernel: High-redshift observations and mass estimates are real but model-sensitive.
standard_equation_or_locator: Galaxy population synthesis and cosmological structure model.
proposed_component: Use JWST as a stress test of formation physics, not as static-universe proof.
observable_or_endpoint: Spectroscopic redshift, stellar mass posterior, selection and AGN controls.
falsifier_or_next_test: Separate confirmed spectroscopy from photometric candidates and run sensitivity to population priors.
limitations: The implication is under active study; do not promote a cosmological replacement.

claim_statement: AEOF can make cross-domain analogies auditable without asserting a common hidden mechanism.
established_kernel: Evidence status, standard equations, and falsifiers are established research-governance practices.
proposed_component: Use a typed record as an ASTRA methods contribution.
observable_or_endpoint: Coverage, reproducibility, and successful rejection of overclaims.
falsifier_or_next_test: Independent reviewer should find no analogy-to-evidence promotion and all records should have locators and falsifiers.
limitations: Method novelty and priority remain unknown until a bounded prior-art search is recorded.

claim_statement: A coherence-support-release phase diagram is a proposed cross-domain scaling hypothesis.
established_kernel: The named domains each have domain-specific stability and relaxation models.
proposed_component: "Test whether a domain-specific normalization yields an out-of-sample scaling law."
observable_or_endpoint: Instability boundary, release fraction, relaxation scaling.
null_model: Independent domain-specific models with no shared scaling.
falsifier_or_next_test: Fit on held-out domains and preserve failures; reject if the relation is post-hoc or non-identifying.
limitations: Similar phase portraits do not establish a shared substance or universal exponent.
